---
name: frontend-scaffold
description: 'Create approved frontend placeholder scaffolding and design-system foundation without implementing product behaviors.'
agent: frontend-ui-engineer
---

Proceed only after explicit `APPROVE DESIGN v1`, `APPROVE CONTRACTS v1` and `APPROVE SCAFFOLD v1`.

Before edits inspect git status, frontend framework/version, existing component library, routing, tests and build scripts. Do not overwrite existing components.

Create only the approved scaffold: application shell, route placeholders, token files, base typography, semantic theme variables and empty component contracts. Do not create fake data, fake analytics or fake backend behavior. Do not add dependencies unless separately approved. No feature implementation. Run exact type/lint/build checks and report their outputs.
